args.lesson: STOP: Reddit returns 403 to FETCH and community.shopify.com search returns a 189-byte JS shell ('This is not the content you are looking for'), so neither yields forum posts. Both are dead sources for demand evidence via FETCH; do not plan demand tests on them. Next time, before designing a demand test, pick sources that serve server-rendered or JSON content to plain GET (e.g. Discourse forums' /search.json, Stack Exchange API, GitHub issues API), and check one small fetch first. Zero observed requests here is a fetch limitation, not zero demand.
